items.title: Model Context Protocol — Introduction
items.snippet: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that standardizes how applications provide context to large language models.

items.title: Introducing the Model Context Protocol
items.snippet: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard that enables developers to build secure, two-way connections between their data sources and AI-powered tools.
items.htmlSnippet: The Model Context Protocol is an open standard that enables developers to build secure, two-way connections.
